title: Windcliffe Inn and Blossom Seeley's trio
summary: He led the band at the Windcliffe Inn with entertainers, and Blossom Seeley hired the trio to New York, where he stayed four or five years.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Then he quit playing. Yeah. So, then I ran into, we went to a place. He put me down to a place called the Windcliffe Inn. First out to Al Trendy's in Chicago, then down to the Windcliffe Inn. And we had some entertainers on there. Benny Fields, Benny Davis, Jack Salisbury, Charlie Thorpe. And I had the band. And we, it got to be a hot spot too.
So, just, things getting hot, see? So, we, first, you know, a girl by the name of Blossom Silly.

Came to Chicago. And she came down to the joint and she got a lot of room. And these fellas had a marvelous trio. Syncopated trio. You know, they did all kind of, they sang and they broke up the rhythm. It's finger snaps, you know, and hit the collars.

And give it back. Everything but was in rhythm, but perfect. Yeah. See, they got a lot of that and she said, I want you guys some next year. Oh, I'll wear that some more. Baloney, see? But sure enough, next year it comes, she brought us in New York. And tore that palace out of the pieces. And from there on, I kept going. I was with Celia for about four or five years. Then I came to the coast. Joined Abe Lyman.
